Sample.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/5] Subjects in each cohort were randomly assigned to one of three conditions: (a) Adolescent-Only, a cognitive-behavioral psychoeducational group for adolescents only (N = 19); (b) Adolescent-and-Parent, an identical group for adolescents with their parents enrolled in a separate parent group (N = 21); and (c) a wait-list condition (N = 19).

IPT.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/5] (a) Adolescent-Only, a cognitive-behavioral psychoeducational group for adolescents only
